newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/GREECE OFFERS TO INJECT FUNDS VIA 14-DAY REPO.
newsitem.headline: BANK/GREECE OFFERS TO INJECT FUNDS VIA 14-DAY REPO.

text.p: The Bank of Greece offered to inject an unspecified amount of drachmas via a 14-day repo auction on Wednesday at 12.30 percent, it said in a statement.

"The Bank of Greece will conduct a fixed-rate repo auction (volume tender) on Wednesday. The auction will involve the sale of government securities (book entry form) owned by credit institutions to the Bank of Greece with an agreement to repurchase on August 27," it said.
The selling price was set at 80.0 percent, and the repurchase price at 80.3774 percent, it said.
The minimum amount per bid is 500 million drachmas ($1.7 million).
"In case of oversubscription, bids will be satisfied pro-rata, with a minimum allotment of 400 million drachmas," it said.
Auction results will be announced to participating banks no later than 1030 GMT (1330 local) on Wednesday.

On August 6, the Bank of Greece injected 78.9 billion drachmas through a repo auction at 12.60 percent. The funds mature later on Wednesday. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4 ($ = 291.6 Greek Drachmas)
